Summary: [BE-1] Ingestion pipeline — website crawl + pricing JSON
Description:
Branch: be/ingestion-pipeline
Repo: ata_rag_be
Depends on: main scaffold (Flyway/pgvector/Docker)

Scope:
- Recursive crawl of https://akademiata.pl (HTML + PDF)
- Deny login/admin/search/feed/tag/category paths; do NOT use akademiata.edu.pl Moodle as base
- Clean HTML → Markdown → heading-aware chunking + metadata (url, title, section, language, hash, source_type=website)
- Separate pricing ingest from Google Apps Script JSON (PRICING_API_URL / akademiataPrices); source_type=pricing; citation URL https://akademiata.pl/kalkulator-czesnego/
- Content-hash incremental re-embed; daily scheduled sync (~03:00)
- Persist crawl_runs + pricing job runs; failed URL reporting
- Expand Flyway schema for pages/chunks embeddings

Out of scope: chat API, admin UI auth

Acceptance:
- Re-run is idempotent
- Website and pricing chunks distinguishable by source_type
- Failed pages/jobs queryable

Verify: ./mvnw test (ingest fixtures); docker compose up postgres

- Empty/low-confidence → graceful unknown message
- Streaming works through nginx (buffering off)
